youtube.description: Hinako Konohana seems like the perfect, elegant rich girl, but behind closed doors she's a total disaster who can't handle basic chores. Ordinary student Itsuki Tomonari becomes her 24/7 caretaker, constantly covering up her messy reality while trying to keep up appearances. Their awkward, chaotic daily life gradually softens into something that feels like love. Dive into the comedic and heartfelt romance of *Rich Girl Caretaker* — where a perfect image meets messy reality! #RichGirlCaretaker #Anime #Comedy #Romance #AnimeStory #MangaAdaptation #Crunchyroll #AnimeReview #AnimeExplained #AnimeFans
